name: paper-reader
description: 本地文献阅读与 PDF 标注工具（Electron + MySQL）

scripts.llm:check: node --check electron/llm/llama-core.js && node --check electron/llm/translate-worker.js && node --check electron/llm/translator-service.js && node --check electron/llm/chat-worker.js && node --check electron/llm/local-chat-service.js && node --check electron/ipc/translate.js && node --check electron/ipc/ai.js
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/dist.mjs --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:win:with-model: npm run model:stage && npm run dist:win
scripts.dist:mac:with-model: npm run model:stage && npm run dist:mac
scripts.dist:linux:with-model: npm run model:stage && npm run dist:linux
